# Remix winning competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library into new angles

**Competitor ads running 30+ days become 10–20 original concepts for your product, each with a hook, proof shot and provable claims.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_b787efe35e8f.webp" alt="A remixed vertical product ad: a driver drops her phone between the seats, then hands fit a leather gap filler that catches coins and keys." width="480"></p>

Turns winning competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Kalodata or FastMoss into new ad angles for your own product, without copying them: rank ads by winner signals (running 30+ days, many variants, reach), break the top ones down with varg video_analyze (hook, angle, format, offer, proof, CTA, awareness level), map which angles and formats the market already runs, generate 10-20 new concepts (same angle in a new format, same format with a new angle, one awareness level up or down) using only claims you can prove, check originality, and hand each concept to a varg skill to produce. Use when a seller says "clone this winning ad", "what are my competitors running", "find winning ads for my product", "spy on TikTok Shop ads", "give me new angles", or pastes Ad Library or Creative Center links. Not for re-uploading or re-cutting someone else's footage (never), and not for one ad's 20 variants (use varg-ad-variants).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-ad-library-remix                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-ad-library-remix --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 10–20 ad concepts with hooks and claims |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.05 per analyzed ad (video_analyze) |
